I didn't have enough plates for when family came around as a couple of my dinner plates got broken. However, thanks to Amazon prime these were delivered the next day just when I needed them and they are nice strong, sturdy, good quality plates, they are white so will go with any decor and they look great. They look more expensive than they are. The thickness of each plate is good, they don't chip or break easily. They arrived very well packaged. They are functional as they can be microwaved, I don't have a dishwasher, I am the dishwasher but I'm pretty sure they could go in a dishwasher. Very easy to use, good size for any meal.

Great plates.

I was looking for something that was not made for giants to eat dinner off of. These are normal dinner sized plates. Maybe that shows my age, but the size of plates these days is getting silly.

Nice price for a basic white plate, and have held up well in the dishwasher. Not cumbersome, not heavy, just what you expect from a dinner plate. And fits in the microwave unlike the platter sized dinner plates forced in us these days.
